title: Analysis of heme and iron influence on Porphyromonas gingivalis gene expression
author: Śmiga, Michał
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0
materials: For internal labeling control, the total RNA was spiked with in vitro synthesized polyadenylated transcripts (One-Color RNA Spike-In Mix; Agilent Technologies). Subsequently, samples were reverse transcribed into cDNA and then converted into cyanine-3-labeled complementary RNA (cRNA) with Low Input Quick-Amp Labeling Kit One-Color (Agilent Technologies). For microarray hybridization, a Gene Expression Hybridization Kit (Agilent Technologies) was used. Labeled cRNA was hybridized for 17 hours at 65℃ on Agilent Custom GE 8×15K Microarrays, washed according to the manufacturer's protocol, and dried with acetonitrile (Sigma-Aldrich). The fluorescence of samples was detected with Scan Control A.8.4.1 software (Agilent Technologies) on the Agilent DNA Microarray Scanner (Agilent Technologies) and extracted from the images using Feature Extraction 10.7.3.1 software (Agilent Technologies). For data analysis, Feature Extraction 10.7.3.1 (Agilent Technologies), GeneSpring GX 13.1.1 (Agilent Technologies), and Excel 2010 (Microsoft, Redmond, WA, USA) were used. For statistical analysis, Welch's approximate t -test was used. Differences in gene expression are shown as fold change values (FC). The average was calculated from the normalized signal values and they were transformed from the log2 to the linear scale. Increases and decreases in gene expression are shown as positive and negative numbers, respectively. The fold change in gene expression was considered significant for FC ≥ 2 or FC ≤ -2 and P -value ≤ 0.05 Ciuraszkiewicz J, Śmiga M, Mackiewicz P, Gmiterek A, Bielecki M, Olczak M, Olczak T.
Śmiga M, Ślęzak P, Olczak T.

steps.title: Prepare basal growth medium
steps.instruction: Make basal medium containing 3 % (v/v) trypticase soy broth and 0.5 % (w/v) yeast extract, then add 3.6 mM L‑cysteine hydrochloride and 0.5 mg L⁻¹ menadione; keep the medium anaerobic (80 % N₂, 10 % H₂, 10 % CO₂).

steps.title: Add condition‑specific supplements
steps.instruction: For iron‑ and heme‑limited cultures, supplement the basal medium with 0.16 mM 2,2‑dipyridyl (DIP). For iron‑ and heme‑rich cultures, supplement with 0.0077 mM hemin chloride (Hm).

steps.title: Inoculate and incubate strains
steps.instruction: Inoculate Porphyromonas gingivalis A7436 and ATCC 33277 into the appropriate DIP or Hm medium, set up three biological replicates per strain per condition, and incubate anaerobically for 20 hours.

steps.title: Harvest cells and isolate total RNA
steps.instruction: After 20 h growth, collect bacterial cells and isolate total RNA using the protocol of Curaszkiewicz et al. 2014.

steps.title: Determine RNA quantity and quality
steps.instruction: Measure RNA concentration and assess integrity exactly as described by Curaszkiewicz et al. 2014.

steps.title: Spike RNA with internal control
steps.instruction: Add the One‑Color RNA Spike‑In Mix (Agilent Technologies) to each RNA sample as an internal labeling control.

steps.title: Synthesize Cy3‑labeled cRNA
steps.instruction: Reverse‑transcribe the spiked RNA to cDNA and then generate cyanine‑3‑labeled complementary RNA (cRNA) using the Low Input Quick‑Amp Labeling Kit One‑Color (Agilent Technologies).

steps.title: Hybridize labeled cRNA to microarray
steps.instruction: Combine the Cy3‑labeled cRNA with the Gene Expression Hybridization Kit (Agilent Technologies) and hybridize to Agilent Custom GE 8×15K microarrays for 17 hours at 65 °C.

steps.title: Wash and dry microarray
steps.instruction: Wash the hybridized microarrays according to the manufacturer’s protocol and dry them with acetonitrile (Sigma‑Aldrich).

steps.title: Scan microarray and extract data
steps.instruction: Scan the dried arrays using an Agilent DNA Microarray Scanner controlled by Scan Control A.8.4.1 software; extract fluorescence intensities with Feature Extraction 10.7.3.1 software (Agilent Technologies).

steps.title: Analyze data and test significance
steps.instruction: Process extracted data with Feature Extraction 10.7.3.1, GeneSpring GX 13.1.1, and Excel 2010; calculate normalized signal values, convert log₂ to linear scale, compute fold‑change (FC), and apply Welch’s approximate t‑test, considering FC ≥ 2 or ≤ ‑2 with p ≤ 0.05 as significant.
